mapper.sql: t.id AS database_id, t.business_id, t.plan_id, t.task_key, t.request_id, t.expert_id, t.session_id, t.status, t.objective, t.expected_output, t.acceptance_criteria, t.result_json, t.correction_of, t.correction_count, t.dependencies, t.required_capabilities, t.last_sequence
mapper.select: SELECT d.business_id FROM coordinator_dispatch d WHERE d.status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND d.available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (d.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR d.lease_expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coordinator_dispatch older WHERE older.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND older.project_id = d.project_id AND older.conversation_id = d.conversation_id AND older.status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND (older.created_at < d.created_at OR (older.created_at = d.created_at AND older.id < d.id))) ORDER BY d.created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE coordinator_dispatch SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{dispatchId} AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
UPDATE coordinator_dispatch SET lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{dispatchId} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT d.business_id AS dispatch_id, d.tenant_id, d.project_id, d.conversation_id, d.message_id, m.user_id, m.message_text, m.attachment_refs, c.session_id AS business_session_id, c.coordinator_session_id FROM coordinator_dispatch d JOIN project_message m ON m.business_id = d.message_id JOIN project_conversation c ON c.business_id = d.conversation_id WHERE d.business_id = #{dispatchId}
SELECT business_id AS id FROM coordinator_plan WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coordinator_plan (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, conversation_id, message_id, analysis_id, status, intent_json) VALUES (#{id}, #{work.tenantId}, #{work.projectId}, #{work.conversationId}, #{work.messageId}, #{analysisId}, 'RUNNING', #{intentJson})

INSERT INTO coordinator_plan (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, conversation_id, message_id, analysis_id, plan_version, status, intent_json, plan_json, repair_count) VALUES (#{id}, #{work.tenantId}, #{work.projectId}, #{work.conversationId}, #{work.messageId}, #{analysisId}, #{planVersion}, 'RUNNING', #{intentJson}, #{planJson}, #{repairCount})

INSERT INTO coordinator_plan (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, conversation_id, message_id, analysis_id, plan_version, status, intent_json, plan_json, repair_count, supersedes_plan_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{work.tenantId}, #{work.projectId}, #{work.conversationId}, #{work.messageId}, #{analysisId}, #{planVersion}, 'RUNNING', #{intentJson}, #{planJson}, #{repairCount}, #{supersedesPlanId})
mapper.update: UPDATE coordinator_plan SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{planId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM coordinator_task t JOIN coordinator_plan p ON p.business_id = t.plan_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.message_id = #{messageId} AND p.status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY t.created_at, t.task_key
mapper.update: UPDATE coordinator_task SET expert_id = #{expertId}, status = 'STARTING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coordinator_task WHERE expert_id = #{expertId} AND status IN ('STARTING', 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE coordinator_task SET status = 'CORRECTING', correction_count = 1, result_accepted = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{taskId} AND correction_count = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coordinator_task (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, plan_id, task_key, request_id, expert_id, status, objective, attachment_refs, dependencies, required_capabilities, expected_output, acceptance_criteria, correction_of, correction_count) VALUES (#{id}, #{work.tenantId}, #{work.projectId}, #{planId}, #{taskKey}, #{requestId}, '', 'PENDING', #{objective}, #{attachmentRefs}, #{dependencies}, #{requiredCapabilities}, #{expectedOutput}, #{acceptanceCriteria}, #{correctionOf}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE coordinator_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_json = #{resultJson}, result_accepted = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{correctionOf}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coordinator_task (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, plan_id, task_key, request_id, expert_id, status, objective, attachment_refs) VALUES (#{id}, #{work.tenantId}, #{work.projectId}, #{planId}, 'single-task', #{requestId}, #{expertId}, 'PENDING', #{objective}, #{attachmentRefs})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS database_id, t.business_id, t.plan_id, t.request_id, t.expert_id, t.session_id, t.status, t.last_sequence FROM coordinator_task t JOIN coordinator_plan p ON p.business_id = t.plan_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.update: UPDATE coordinator_task SET session_id = #{sessionId}, status = 'RUNNING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{taskId} AND session_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_conversation_expert_session (id, tenant_id, project_id, conversation_id, expert_id, session_id, message_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{conversationId}, #{expertId}, #{sessionId}, #{messageId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE session_id = VALUES(session_id), message_id = VALUES(message_id)
mapper.select: SELECT coordinator_agent_id FROM project_conversation WHERE business_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coordinator_task_event (business_id, tenant_id, task_id, event_id, sequence, event_type, payload) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{taskId}, #{eventId}, #{sequence}, #{eventType}, #{payload})
mapper.update: UPDATE coordinator_task SET status = #{status}, last_sequence = #{sequence}, result_json = #{resultJson}, result_accepted = #{resultAccepted}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{taskId} AND last_sequence < #{sequence} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'TIMED_OUT')
UPDATE coordinator_plan SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{planId}
UPDATE coordinator_plan SET status = 'FAILED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND message_id = #{messageId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE coordinator_task SET status = 'FAILED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE plan_id IN (SELECT business_id FROM coordinator_plan WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND message_id = #{messageId}) AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'STARTING', 'PENDING')

UPDATE coordinator_task SET status = 'PENDING', expert_id = '', last_sequence = 0, consecutive_failures = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE plan_id IN (SELECT business_id FROM coordinator_plan WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND message_id = #{messageId} AND status = 'RUNNING') AND status = 'STARTING' AND session_id IS NULL AND updated_at < #{cutoff}

UPDATE coordinator_task SET status = #{status}, result_json = #{resultJson}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{taskId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'TIMED_OUT')
UPDATE coordinator_task SET consecutive_failures = consecutive_failures + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT consecutive_failures FROM coordinator_task WHERE business_id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE coordinator_task SET consecutive_failures = 0 WHERE business_id = #{taskId} AND consecutive_failures <> 0
UPDATE coordinator_dispatch SET lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{dispatchId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coordinator_task (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, plan_id, task_key, request_id, expert_id, status, objective, attachment_refs, dependencies, required_capabilities, expected_output, acceptance_criteria) VALUES (#{id}, #{work.tenantId}, #{work.projectId}, #{planId}, #{taskKey}, #{requestId}, '', 'PENDING', #{objective}, #{attachmentRefs}, #{dependencies}, #{requiredCapabilities}, #{expectedOutput}, #{acceptanceCriteria})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM coordinator_task t WHERE t.plan_id = #{planId} AND t.task_key = #{taskKey} AND t.status = 'SUCCEEDED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coordinator_task (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, plan_id, task_key, request_id, expert_id, session_id, status, objective, attachment_refs, result_json, last_sequence, dependencies, required_capabilities, expected_output, acceptance_criteria, result_accepted, reused_from_task_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{work.tenantId}, #{work.projectId}, #{planId}, #{taskKey}, #{requestId}, #{expertId}, #{sessionId}, 'SUCCEEDED', #{objective}, #{attachmentRefs}, #{resultJson}, #{lastSequence}, #{dependencies}, #{requiredCapabilities}, #{expectedOutput}, #{acceptanceCriteria}, TRUE, #{reusedFromTaskId})
